title: All is well … until all is lost
body:
Any.do is certainly a great concept, easy to use, flexible, and decent to look at, and it works great most of the time. I struggle, however, with its reliablity in the long run.

I've had this app now for maybe a year and a half. Today is the third time it has simply deleted all my todos without any form of warning. When I open the app it gives me the welcome splash screen as if it's the first time, and although I sign in with the same account as before, all the missing items are still gone. This tends to happen at the worst possible moments, on average about every six months. Last time was my 2015 Christmas preparation plans, this time I'm planning a vacation and a wedding party. All gone.

The FAQ says "Sometimes the syncing process cannot complete and your tasks do not fully load. Please log out and back into the app on all platforms - this will retrieve the most current information that is on our server."

Following this advice, I managed to recall a single entry from over a year ago, which I had long deleted from the list after completion, but none of the recent ones were there.

I strongly feel that I can't trust Any.do, and that I've given it more that a fair dose of patience and second chances, so I'm kicking it out. Adieu.
